questions.stem: The device designed to protect person from electric shock is ______________.

questions.stem: The complementary color of red light is ______________ light.
explanation_steps: Complementary colors are pairs of colors that produce white light when combined. For the primary colors of light (RGB), the complements are: Red-Cyan, Green-Magenta, and Blue-Yellow.

questions.stem: The Energy transmission occurs in an electric motor is from ____________ to ___________ Energy.
